summary: Iteration 4: JWT auth (register/login/me/protected), multi-tenant isolation, per-clinic email sender (Resend), public booking safety, 24h SMS reminders, cron secret, sms_24h template — all verified. Backend: 25/25 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_auth_tenant.py. Iteration 1-3 regression tests (backend_test.py, 33 tests) not re-run because those endpoints are now behind auth — new file covers regression touching auth (dashboard, roi/pdf, patients list, settings, templates). Frontend Playwright: /panel→/logowanie redirect works; wrong password shows login-error 'Nieprawidłowy email lub hasło'; correct login lands on /panel with user-email + clinic-name + logout-btn; /ustawienia email-sender-card toggles badge from 'Domena Emergent (domyślna)' → 'Własna domena: przypomnienia@gabinet.pl' after save-settings-btn; test-email-btn with bad Resend key produces toast 'Resend: API key is invalid' (400); /szablony sms-24h-template visible, edit + save-templates-btn OK; /wiadomosci send-24h-btn triggers dispatch, badge-24h appears on 24h reminder card; logout returns to /logowanie; /rejestracja submits successfully and lands on /panel with user-email of new account.

minor.issue: For clinics whose templates doc was created before the sms_24h field existed, GET returns no sms_24h key (no defaults backfill). UI treats missing as empty string and PUT persists correctly, so functionally OK, but users may see an empty field even though DEFAULT_TEMPLATES has a good default. Fix: merge DEFAULT_TEMPLATES on read, or run a one-time backfill on startup.

integration_issues.issue: Immediately after /rejestracja succeeds and redirects to /panel, sidebar clinic-name renders default 'Gabinet' rather than the newly submitted nazwa_gabinetu. Backend confirms settings.nazwa_gabinetu is correct within ~1s, so this is a client-side stale-read race (Layout fetches settings before background _seed_new_clinic finishes). Fix: refetch settings after registration success or drive clinic-name from user.clinic_id/user-side field.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (ResponsiveContainer inside a briefly zero-size parent). Purely cosmetic console noise; chart renders after mount.

action_items: Merge DEFAULT_TEMPLATES on GET /api/templates (or backfill sms_24h) so pre-existing template docs expose the field.
Post-registration: force a settings refetch (or drive sidebar clinic-name from user.nazwa_gabinetu) so the new clinic name appears immediately without race.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py cookies set with samesite='none' + secure=True is correct for cross-origin preview, but CORS is added AFTER routers with allow_origins from env — verify CORS_ORIGINS env matches the preview host so that cookie-based refresh actually works from the browser.
server.py is now 1340 lines; splitting auth-gated resources (patients, settings, reminders, booking, cron) into routers modules is overdue.
_public_settings strips resend_api_key/email_reply_to before returning booking gabinet — verified. Good.
send_24h_reminders is idempotent per appointment via przypomnienie_24h flag — verified: second call returns wyslano:0.
run_daily_recall_all_clinics iterates clinics with set_clinic; on exception it logs but continues — good.

seed_admin.migrate_orphans reassigns docs without clinic_id to admin clinic and seeds again if empty — potentially double-seeds if admin already has some data but was re-created; low-risk given first-run scenario.
Templates GET does not merge DEFAULT_TEMPLATES; legacy docs miss sms_24h field.
